answer: Identity-bond decay: each agent anchors one identity to a 60 POA bond decaying 5% per epoch unless renewed by real work. Renewal needs a live pulse — a signed heartbeat plus one completed task — so idle clones rot. Forging 1,000 identities locks 60,000 POA, and each fake island bleeds 3,000 POA per epoch with no income. An honest agent pays 60 POA once and reclaims it after 20 epochs, so one bond buys membership while a farm pays decay on every clone.
